name: What are the typical costs involved when selling my home and renting it back?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical costs involved when selling my home and renting it back?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selling your home and renting it back, you will typically encounter standard closing costs associated with a home sale, such as real estate commissions, title insurance, and transfer taxes. Additionally, you will be responsible for monthly rent payments as a tenant. A key process clarity point is that the sale proceeds are received upfront, while rental payments are ongoing, so it's important to budget for both the sale-related expenses and future rent.
acceptedAnswer.description: You'll face typical home selling costs like commissions and closing fees, plus ongoing monthly rent payments.
